Definition (En): The document is in good physical condition, with no significant damage or deterioration.
The document shows some signs of wear or minor damage but remains fully usable.
The document is significantly damaged or deteriorated, affecting its usability.
The document has sustained physical damage, such as tears, water damage, or staining.
The document is intact but physically weak and requires careful handling to avoid further damage.
The condition of the document has not been assessed or recorded.
